name: ZclockID Enterprise v1.2.5
summary: Modular UI View Templates, Layout Wrapping Fixes, and Frontend Performance Optimizations
notes:
### What's Changed in v1.2.5:
* **Modular View Templates:** Decomposed monolithic 6,700-line index.html into lightweight asynchronous view partials under web/views/tabs/ and web/views/modals.html, shrinking main document by 97% to ~210 lines.
* **Asynchronous Tab & Modal Loader:** Implemented on-demand template loading with in-memory DOM caching and background idle preloading for instant zero-latency sub-millisecond tab switching.
* **Sidebar & Subtab Layout Hardening:** Fixed text wrapping on Users, Groups & Computers tab button when active, widened navigation sidebar (w-72), and added flex-nowrap to directory subtabs container.
* **Production Governance Compliance:** Verified and compiled strictly on dedicated build server 192.168.1.41.
